integrity: Mathematical proof supplies all-parameter result. Bundled exhaustive checks verify illustrative orders 2 and 3; they are not universal proof. Independent validation is not performed.
limitations: Finite thick generalized quadrangles with an existing incidence geometry only, unit shortest-path metric and inclusive integer scales. No assertion about excluded degenerate orders, arbitrary existence, equvariance, or independent priority assessment.
title: Uniform scale-three Vietoris–Rips homotopy and persistence of generalized quadrangles
